title: LTE Metrics Catalogue
header: LTE — 345 metrics + NR 16 · 449 NFF 2.19 documented fields read · headers, counters and identities excluded · ★ = per cell: PCell · SCell1–4 (LTE) · PSCell · SCell NR — every ★ metric expands into 7 leaves (PCell, SCell1–4, PSCell, SCell NR) — NR leaves stay greyed until P4 proof is done, never hidden · ⚑ = event (0/1 + attributes)
